fusions.name: Caught Looking
fusions.desc: A snagging weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Picked Out
fusions.desc: Throws a barbed dart that deals 22 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 60% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Hold My Gaze
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fastened Tight
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 7% more damage per stack (33% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
